verdict.rationale: The pricing page confirms usage-based, pay-per-minute billing with a free tier ('pay only for the minutes that run'), which supports pre-commitment cost awareness, but the evidence pack contains no published rate table, per-provider cost breakdown, or a cost calculator/estimator tool. Missing for 10: detailed per-minute rate figures, breakdown by model/voice/transcriber provider costs, and any calculator or estimation tool referenced in docs.
